_comment: SHAPE ONLY - do NOT paste this file. Run `<PY> bootstrap.py --install --verify-key` (any Python 3.6+; no git needed, no Python on PATH needed). It writes the real absolute paths into ~/.workbuddy-ai/mcp.json, into ~/.workbuddy/mcp.json when that folder exists, and into mcp.local.json. No key, no env, no headers.
_note_macos_linux: On macOS/Linux setup generates ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_THIS_REPO/.venv/bin/python instead of .venv/Scripts/python.exe. bootstrap.py runs on macOS's stock Python 3.9 and finds a 3.10+ interpreter (WorkBuddy bundled, Homebrew or python.org). A one-time Python install is needed ONLY if none exists anywhere.
